// js/app.js
// Entry point. Wires the data, navigation state machine, globe, search box and
// UI together.
//
// What happens when you land on a place:
//   1. The camera flies there; the info panel slides in.
//   2. We ask the Census Bureau which layers of government cover the exact
//      point (federal, state, congressional district, legislature, county,
//      city, school district, ward...) -> the "layer dock" and ballot sections.
//   3. Each layer's outline is fetched and drawn on the globe, glowing, in its
//      own color. Hover / click a layer to highlight it.
//   4. States and counties are clickable shapes; cities are pins.
//
// Ways to move: click a country/state/county/pin, pick from the menus, search,
// press "Use my location", or go Up / back to the whole world.
//
// Candidates: race cards, the search box and the intro all open a candidate's
// research profile (js/candidate-sheet.js). `?candidate=<slug>` deep-links to one.

import { Navigation } from "./navigation.js";
import { Globe } from "./globe.js";
import { UI } from "./ui.js";
import { SearchBox } from "./search.js";
import { CandidateSheet } from "./candidate-sheet.js";
import { getCurrentPosition } from "./geolocation.js";
import {
  fetchRacesForPlace,
  fetchEventsForPlace,
  fetchStack,
  fetchBoundary,
  fetchChildShapes,
  loadChildren,
  resolveFromPoint,
  resolvePlaceFromGeocode,
  resolvePlaceByCoords,
} from "../data/civic.js";
import { kindMeta } from "../data/kinds.js";
import { getCandidate, racesForState } from "../data/candidates.js";

const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const THEME_KEY = "mapachusetts-theme";

// ----- Setup --------------------------------------------------------------------

let theme = "night";
try {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY);
  if (saved === "day" || saved === "night") theme = saved;
} catch {
  /* private mode: just use the default */
}

const nav = new Navigation();

// Where the exact point came from, for the note under the place name.
let pointSource = null; // "search" | "gps" | null

// The layer dock's state (which layers, which outlines have loaded, which is focused).
const dock = { status: "loading", stack: [], loaded: new Set(), focusId: null };

const globe = new Globe(
  "map",
  {
    // A city pin was clicked.
    onPlaceClick: (node) => nav.descendTo(node),

    // A state / county outline was clicked.
    onShapeClick: async (shape) => {
      let node = nav.current.children.find((c) => c.geoid === shape.geoid);
      if (!node) {
        await loadChildren(nav.current);
        node = nav.current.children.find((c) => c.geoid === shape.geoid);
      }
      if (node) nav.descendTo(node);
    },

    // A country was clicked on the zoomed-out globe: the U.S. opens, anywhere
    // else explains that it isn't available yet.
    onRegionClick: (region) => {
      if (region.active) {
        if (nav.current.level === "globe") nav.jumpTo("usa");
      } else {
        ui.setStatus(
          `${region.name} isn't available yet. Mapachusetts covers the United States for now.`,
          "warn",
          4500
        );
      }
    },

    // The map key is only useful while the shading is visible.
    onZoom: (zoom) => ui.setLegendVisible(zoom < 5.2),
  },
  theme
);

const ui = new UI(
  {
    body: document.body,
    navigator: $("navigator"),
    browse: $("browse"),
    upBtn: $("upBtn"),
    worldBtn: $("worldBtn"),
    themeBtn: $("themeBtn"),
    legend: $("mapLegend"),
    dock: $("dock"),
    panelTitle: $("panelTitle"),
    panelLevel: $("panelLevel"),
    breadcrumbs: $("breadcrumbs"),
    pointNote: $("pointNote"),
    countdown: $("countdown"),
    tabBallot: $("tabBallot"),
    tabEvents: $("tabEvents"),
    ballotCount: $("ballotCount"),
    eventsCount: $("eventsCount"),
    ballotList: $("ballotList"),
    eventsList: $("eventsList"),
    status: $("status"),
  },
  {
    onAscend: () => nav.ascend(),
    onReset: () => nav.reset(),
    onJump: (id) => nav.jumpTo(id),

    onThemeToggle: () => {
      theme = theme === "night" ? "day" : "night";
      ui.setTheme(theme);
      globe.setTheme(theme);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, theme);
      } catch {
        /* ignore */
      }
    },

    // Dock chip: highlight that layer, show its ballot section, zoom to it.
    onFocusLayer: (id) => focusLayer(id, { frame: true }),
    // Opened a ballot section: just highlight that layer on the globe.
    onSelectLayer: (id) => focusLayer(id),
    onHoverLayer: (id) => globe.setHover(id),
    // A candidate on a race card was clicked.
    onOpenCandidate: (slug) => sheet.open(slug),
  }
);
ui.setTheme(theme);
ui.showTab("ballot");

// The candidate profile sheet. It slides over the dossier.
const sheet = new CandidateSheet($("candidateSheet"));

const search = new SearchBox(
  {
    form: $("searchForm"),
    input: $("searchInput"),
    list: $("searchResults"),
    status: $("searchStatus"),
  },
  {
    onSelect: (desc) => goToDescriptor(desc),
    onSelectCandidate: (slug) => sheet.open(slug),
  }
);

// ----- Layout: keep the place clear of the floating panels ----------------------

const wide = () => window.matchMedia("(min-width: 901px)").matches;

function applyPadding() {
  const world = nav.current.level === "globe";
  if (wide()) {
    // Desktop: intro on the left in the world view, dossier on the right otherwise.
    // (When the Browse panel is open it covers the left edge too.)
    const browseOpen = $("navigator").open;
    globe.setPadding(
      world
        ? { left: 520, right: 0, bottom: 0 }
        : { left: browseOpen ? 372 : 0, right: 480, bottom: 120 }
    );
  } else {
    globe.setPadding({ left: 0, right: 0, bottom: world ? 330 : Math.round(window.innerHeight * 0.56) });
  }
}

// ----- Focusing a layer ------------------------------------------------------------

function focusLayer(id, { frame = false } = {}) {
  dock.focusId = id;
  globe.setFocus(id);
  ui.renderDock(dock);
  if (id && frame) {
    // Only when the person asked for it: open that layer's ballot section and
    // zoom the globe to its outline.
    ui.revealLayer(id);
    const b = globe.boundsOf(id);
    if (b) globe.frame(b);
  }
}

// The layer of government a place level corresponds to.
const levelKind = (level, unincorporated) =>
  level === "country" ? "country"
  : level === "state" ? "state"
  : level === "county" ? "county"
  : unincorporated ? "county" : "city";

// Which layer is "the place we're on" (so it starts highlighted).
function primaryId(stack, level) {
  const want = { state: "state", county: "county", city: "city", district: "city" }[level];
  const j =
    stack.find((x) => x.kind === want) ||
    stack.find((x) => x.kind === "county") ||
    stack.find((x) => x.kind === "state");
  return j ? j.id : null;
}

function pointNote(state) {
  const { current, pointIsExact } = state;
  if (current.level === "city" || current.level === "district") {
    if (pointSource === "gps" && pointIsExact) return "Districts shown are for your location.";
    if (pointIsExact) return "Districts shown are for the spot you searched.";
    return `Districts shown are for the center of ${current.name}. Large cities can be split across several districts, so use your location or search an exact spot to see yours.`;
  }
  return "";
}

// ----- Render on every navigation change --------------------------------------------

let renderSeq = 0;
let firstRender = true;

nav.subscribe(async (state) => {
  const seq = ++renderSeq;
  const stale = () => seq !== renderSeq;
  const { current, path } = state;
  const isWorld = current.level === "globe";
  sheet.close(); // a profile belongs to the place it was opened from

  // Reset everything that belongs to the previous place.
  dock.status = "loading";
  dock.stack = [];
  dock.loaded = new Set();
  dock.focusId = null;
  globe.clearStack();
  globe.setChildShapes(null);
  globe.clearMarkers();

  // Kick off loading of county / city lists (for the menus and pins).
  const loads = path.filter((n) => n.level === "state" || n.level === "county").map(loadChildren);
  if (current.level === "country" || current.level === "globe") loads.push(Promise.resolve());

  ui.setMode(isWorld);
  ui.renderBrowse(nav.getState().browse); // shows "Loading…" while lists load
  ui.renderBreadcrumbs(path);
  ui.renderHeader(current);
  ui.renderPointNote(pointNote(state));
  applyPadding();
  if (!isWorld) ui.renderDock(dock);

  // Camera.
  await globe.ready;
  if (stale()) return;
  if (firstRender && isWorld) {
    globe.initWorldView();
    globe.startSpin();
  } else {
    globe.flyTo(current);
  }
  firstRender = false;

  // Pins for the world view; the rest are drawn below once their data arrives.
  if (isWorld) {
    globe.renderMarkers(state.children);
    ui.renderBallot([], { node: current, stack: [], status: "idle" });
    ui.renderEvents([], current);
    return;
  }

  // 1. Events + the sample-data part of the ballot show up straight away.
  fetchEventsForPlace(current.id).then((events) => {
    if (!stale()) ui.renderEvents(events, current);
  });
  fetchRacesForPlace(current.id, []).then((races) => {
    if (!stale()) {
      ui.renderBallot(races, { node: current, stack: [], status: "loading", openKind: levelKind(current.level) });
    }
  });

  // 2. Clickable shapes and pins for the places below this one.
  showChildren(current, loads, seq);

  // 3. The stack of governments at this spot, then their outlines.
  try {
    const res = await fetchStack(state.point, current.level);
    if (stale()) return;
    dock.stack = res.stack;
    ui.renderDock(dock);

    const races = await fetchRacesForPlace(current.id, res.stack);
    if (stale()) return;
    ui.renderBallot(races, {
      node: current,
      stack: res.stack,
      status: "ready",
      openKind: levelKind(current.level, res.unincorporated),
      unincorporated: res.unincorporated,
      unincorporatedName: res.unincorporatedName,
    });

    if (current.level === "city" || current.level === "district") {
      globe.renderYouPin(state.point, state.pointIsExact ? "You are here" : current.name);
    }
    await drawOutlines(res.stack, primaryId(res.stack, current.level), current, seq);
  } catch (err) {
    if (stale()) return;
    console.warn("Could not load layers of government:", err);
    dock.status = "error";
    ui.renderDock(dock);
    ui.setStatus("The Census boundary service didn't answer. Showing the basics only.", "warn", 6000);
  }
});

// Clickable outlines (states / counties) or pins (cities) for the next level down.
async function showChildren(current, loads, seq) {
  const stale = () => seq !== renderSeq;
  const level = current.level;

  if (level === "country" || level === "state") {
    const fc = await fetchChildShapes(current);
    if (stale()) return;
    if (fc && fc.features.length) {
      globe.setChildShapes(fc);
    } else {
      await Promise.all(loads); // outlines unavailable: fall back to pins
      if (!stale()) globe.renderMarkers(current.children);
    }
  } else if (level === "county") {
    await Promise.all(loads);
    if (!stale()) {
      globe.renderMarkers(current.children);
      ui.renderBrowse(nav.getState().browse);
    }
  }

  // Menus: refresh once the lists have arrived.
  await Promise.all(loads);
  if (!stale()) ui.renderBrowse(nav.getState().browse);
}

// Fetch each layer's outline and draw it; frame the camera on the place's own.
async function drawOutlines(stack, primary, current, seq) {
  const stale = () => seq !== renderSeq;
  const todo = stack.filter((j) => j.kind !== "country");
  todo.sort((a, b) => (a.id === primary ? -1 : b.id === primary ? 1 : 0));

  await Promise.all(
    todo.map(async (j) => {
      const geometry = await fetchBoundary(j);
      if (stale()) return;
      if (geometry) {
        globe.addStackShape({
          id: j.id,
          color: kindMeta(j.kind).color,
          name: j.name,
          kind: j.kind,
          geometry,
        });
        dock.loaded.add(j.id);
      }
      if (j.id === primary) {
        focusLayer(j.id);
        const b = globe.boundsOf(j.id);
        // Remember the outline so coming back is instant and well framed.
        if (b && !current.extent && (current.level === "county" || current.level === "city")) {
          current.extent = b;
          globe.frame(b);
        }
      } else {
        ui.renderDock(dock);
      }
    })
  );
  if (stale()) return;
  dock.status = "ready";
  ui.renderDock(dock);
}

// ----- Search ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function goToDescriptor(desc) {
  ui.setStatus("Finding the layers of government…", "info");
  const level = desc.type === "state" ? "state" : desc.type === "county" ? "county" : "city";
  // A street-level result is an exact spot; a whole city / county / state is not.
  const exact = !["city", "county", "state"].includes(desc.type);

  try {
    const res = await resolveFromPoint(desc.lng, desc.lat, level);
    if (res.path.length <= 1) throw new Error("not in the U.S.");
    pointSource = "search";
    nav.goToPath(res.path, exact && level === "city" ? [desc.lng, desc.lat] : null);
    const deepest = res.path[res.path.length - 1];
    if (level === "city" && res.unincorporated) {
      ui.setStatus(
        `${desc.name} isn't an incorporated city or town, so we're showing ${deepest.name}.`,
        "info",
        6000
      );
    } else {
      ui.setStatus(`Showing ${deepest.name}.`, "success", 3000);
    }
    return;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Census lookup failed; falling back to the search result's names.", err);
  }

  // Fallback: build the path from the geocoder's names alone.
  const path = await resolvePlaceFromGeocode(desc);
  if (path.length <= 1) {
    ui.setStatus(
      `We found “${desc.name}” but can't place it yet. Try a nearby city or state.`,
      "warn",
      6000
    );
    return;
  }
  pointSource = null;
  nav.goToPath(path);
  ui.setStatus(`Showing ${path[path.length - 1].name}.`, "success", 3000);
}

// ----- Geolocation ------------------------------------------------------------------------

const locateBtn = $("locateBtn");

async function locateMe() {
  locateBtn.disabled = true;
  ui.setStatus("Asking your browser for your location…", "info");
  try {
    const { lng, lat } = await getCurrentPosition();
    ui.setStatus("Finding the governments that cover you…", "info");

    let res = null;
    try {
      res = await resolveFromPoint(lng, lat, "city");
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Census lookup failed; using the offline guess.", err);
    }

    if (res && res.path.length <= 1) {
      // The Census service answered, and you're not in the United States.
      ui.setStatus(
        "You appear to be outside the United States. Mapachusetts only covers the U.S. for now, so try searching for a U.S. city or state.",
        "warn",
        8000
      );
      return;
    }

    let path = res ? res.path : await resolvePlaceByCoords(lng, lat); // offline fallback
    if (path.length <= 1) {
      ui.setStatus("We found you, but we don't have details for your area yet. Try the search box.", "warn", 6000);
      return;
    }
    pointSource = res ? "gps" : null;
    nav.goToPath(path, res ? [lng, lat] : null);
    search.setValue("");
    ui.setStatus(`Showing the layers that cover you, in ${path[path.length - 1].name}.`, "success", 4500);
  } catch (err) {
    const msg =
      err && err.code === 1
        ? "Location permission was denied. You can still search for a place or pick one from the lists."
        : err && err.code === 3
        ? "Finding your location took too long. Try again, or search for your city instead."
        : `We couldn't get your location. ${err.message || ""} You can search for a place instead.`;
    ui.setStatus(msg.trim(), "error", 7000);
  } finally {
    locateBtn.disabled = false;
  }
}
locateBtn.addEventListener("click", locateMe);

// ----- Buttons in the intro, keyboard shortcuts ---------------------------------------------

document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  const cand = e.target.closest("[data-candidate]");
  if (cand) {
    sheet.open(cand.dataset.candidate);
    return;
  }
  const jump = e.target.closest("[data-jump]");
  if (jump) {
    pointSource = null;
    nav.jumpTo(jump.dataset.jump);
    return;
  }
  const action = e.target.closest("[data-action]")?.dataset.action;
  if (action === "locate") locateMe();
  if (action === "search") search.focus();
});

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  const typing = /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(document.activeElement?.tagName || "");
  if ((e.key === "/" && !typing) || ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "k")) {
    e.preventDefault();
    search.focus();
  }
});

// ----- Candidates ------------------------------------------------------------------------

// "Meet the candidates" chips in the intro: everyone in a researched race.
(function fillHeroCandidates() {
  const box = $("heroCandidates");
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const race of racesForState("MA")) {
    for (const cand of race.candidates) {
      if (seen.has(cand.slug) || !getCandidate(cand.slug)) continue;
      seen.add(cand.slug);
      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.type = "button";
      btn.className = "chip-btn";
      btn.dataset.candidate = cand.slug;
      btn.textContent = cand.name;
      btn.title = `${race.office}: open ${cand.name}'s profile`;
      box.appendChild(btn);
    }
  }
  box.hidden = seen.size === 0;
  box.previousElementSibling.hidden = seen.size === 0; // its heading
})();

// Deep link: /?candidate=maura-healey
const deepLinked = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("candidate");
if (deepLinked) sheet.open(deepLinked, { focus: false });

// Opening / closing the Browse panel changes how much of the map is covered.
$("navigator").addEventListener("toggle", applyPadding);

// Keep the map sized and padded correctly.
window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
  applyPadding();
  globe.resize();
});

// js/geocode.js
// Place search + reverse geocoding using Photon (https://photon.komoot.io), a
// free, key-less geocoder built on OpenStreetMap data that supports
// search-as-you-type.
//
// PRIVACY: what the user types in the search box, and (only when they press
// "Use my location") their coordinates, are sent to photon.komoot.io. Nothing
// else leaves the browser. If you self-host Photon or switch providers, change
// PHOTON_URL below and adapt `toDescriptor`.
//
// Fair use: the public instance is shared, so keep the debounce in search.js
// and don't hammer it. For production, self-host or use a paid provider.
//
// SCOPE: United States only. Searches are limited to a bounding box around the
// 50 states + DC, and results are also filtered by country code (the box
// overlaps Canada and Mexico). Widen both to support more countries.

const PHOTON_URL = "https://photon.komoot.io";

// minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat: covers the 50 states, including Alaska and Hawaii.
const US_BBOX = "-179.3,18.8,-66.8,71.6";

// Only return real places (not shops, airports, hospitals, ...).
const PLACE_LAYERS = ["city", "county", "state", "district", "locality"];

// Normalized shape the rest of the app uses:
//   { type, name, country, countryCode, state, county, city, lng, lat, extent, label }
function toDescriptor(feature) {
  const p = feature.properties || {};
  const [lng, lat] = feature.geometry.coordinates;
  // Photon's extent is [minLon, maxLat, maxLon, minLat]; convert to
  // [west, south, east, north].
  const extent = Array.isArray(p.extent)
    ? [p.extent[0], p.extent[3], p.extent[2], p.extent[1]]
    : null;
  const desc = {
    type: p.type || "locality",
    name: p.name || "",
    country: p.country || "",
    countryCode: (p.countrycode || "").toUpperCase(),
    state: p.state || "",
    county: p.county || "",
    city: p.city || "",
    lng,
    lat,
    extent,
  };
  desc.label = describe(desc);
  return desc;
}

// Human-friendly label such as "Medford, Middlesex County, Massachusetts, United States".
export function describe(d) {
  const county =
    d.county && d.countryCode === "US" && !/county|parish|borough/i.test(d.county)
      ? `${d.county} County`
      : d.county;
  const parts = [];
  const add = (v) => {
    if (v && !parts.includes(v)) parts.push(v);
  };
  add(d.name);
  if (d.type !== "city" || !d.county) add(d.city);
  if (d.type !== "county") add(county);
  if (d.type !== "state") add(d.state);
  // Everything is in the U.S., so only name the country when it isn't.
  if (d.countryCode !== "US" && d.type !== "country") add(d.country);
  return parts.join(", ");
}

function buildUrl(path, params) {
  const url = new URL(path, PHOTON_URL);
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) v.forEach((item) => url.searchParams.append(k, item));
    else url.searchParams.set(k, v);
  }
  return url.toString();
}

/**
 * Search for places matching free text, e.g. "Sugar Land, TX".
 * @param {string} query
 * @param {AbortSignal} [signal]
 * @returns {Promise<object[]>} descriptors, best match first
 */
export async function searchPlaces(query, signal) {
  const q = query.trim();
  if (q.length < 2) return [];
  const res = await fetch(
    buildUrl("/api/", {
      q,
      limit: 15, // fetch extra: some results are dropped by the U.S. filter
      lang: "en",
      bbox: US_BBOX,
      layer: PLACE_LAYERS,
    }),
    { signal }
  );
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Search failed (${res.status})`);
  const data = await res.json();

  const seen = new Set();
  const results = [];
  for (const f of data.features || []) {
    const d = toDescriptor(f);
    if (!d.name || d.countryCode !== "US") continue;
    const key = d.label.toLowerCase();
    if (seen.has(key)) continue; // Photon sometimes returns near-duplicates
    seen.add(key);
    results.push(d);
    if (results.length >= 6) break;
  }
  return results;
}

/**
 * Find the place at a coordinate (used by "Use my location").
 * @returns {Promise<object|null>}
 */
export async function reversePlace(lng, lat, signal) {
  const res = await fetch(
    buildUrl("/reverse", { lon: lng, lat, lang: "en", limit: 1 }),
    { signal }
  );
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Reverse lookup failed (${res.status})`);
  const data = await res.json();
  const feature = (data.features || [])[0];
  return feature ? toDescriptor(feature) : null;
}

// js/geolocation.js
// Thin promise wrapper around the browser Geolocation API.

export function getCurrentPosition(options = {}) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (!("geolocation" in navigator)) {
      reject(new Error("Geolocation is not supported by this browser."));
      return;
    }
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (pos) =>
        resolve({
          lng: pos.coords.longitude,
          lat: pos.coords.latitude,
          accuracy: pos.coords.accuracy,
        }),
      (err) => reject(err),
      { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000, maximumAge: 0, ...options }
    );
  });
}

// js/search.js
// Search-as-you-type place picker (an accessible "combobox").
//
// - Type a place ("Medford, MA", "Sugar Land TX", "Paris") and pick a result.
// - Works with mouse, touch and keyboard (Up/Down, Enter, Escape).
// - Requests are debounced and cancelled when superseded, to be kind to the
//   shared public geocoder (see js/geocode.js).

import { searchPlaces } from "./geocode.js";
import { searchCandidates } from "../data/candidates.js";

const DEBOUNCE_MS = 300;

export class SearchBox {
  /**
   * @param {object} refs - { form, input, list, status }
   * @param {object} handlers - { onSelect(descriptor), onSelectCandidate(slug) }
   */
  constructor(refs, handlers = {}) {
    this.refs = refs;
    this.handlers = handlers;
    this.results = [];
    this.activeIndex = -1;
    this._timer = null;
    this._abort = null;
    this._seq = 0;

    const { form, input } = refs;

    input.addEventListener("input", () => this._onInput());
    input.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => this._onKeyDown(e));
    input.addEventListener("focus", () => {
      if (this.results.length) this._open();
    });

    form.addEventListener("submit", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      this._submit();
    });

    // Close the list when clicking elsewhere.
    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      if (!form.contains(e.target)) this._close();
    });
  }

  focus() {
    this.refs.input.focus();
  }

  setValue(text) {
    this.refs.input.value = text;
  }

  // ----- Input handling ----------------------------------------------------

  _onInput() {
    const q = this.refs.input.value.trim();
    clearTimeout(this._timer);
    if (this._abort) this._abort.abort();

    if (q.length < 2) {
      this.results = [];
      this._render();
      this._close();
      this._message("");
      return;
    }
    // Candidates are searched locally, so they appear instantly.
    this._candidates = candidateResults(q);
    if (this._candidates.length) {
      this.results = this._candidates;
      this.activeIndex = 0;
      this._render();
      this._open();
    }
    this._message("Searching…");
    this._timer = setTimeout(() => this._run(q), DEBOUNCE_MS);
  }

  async _run(q) {
    const seq = ++this._seq;
    this._abort = new AbortController();
    try {
      const places = await searchPlaces(q, this._abort.signal);
      if (seq !== this._seq) return; // a newer search is in flight
      const results = [...candidateResults(q), ...places];
      this.results = results;
      this.activeIndex = results.length ? 0 : -1;
      this._render();
      if (results.length) {
        this._open();
        this._message(
          `${results.length} suggestion${results.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Use the arrow keys and Enter to choose.`
        );
      } else {
        this._open();
        this._message("");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.name === "AbortError") return;
      if (seq !== this._seq) return;
      this.results = candidateResults(q);
      this._render(
        this.results.length
          ? null
          : "We couldn't reach the search service. Check your connection, or pick a place from the lists instead."
      );
      this._open();
      this._message("Place search is unavailable right now.");
    }
  }

  _onKeyDown(e) {
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!this.results.length) return;
      this._open();
      this._setActive((this.activeIndex + 1) % this.results.length);
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!this.results.length) return;
      this._setActive(
        (this.activeIndex - 1 + this.results.length) % this.results.length
      );
    } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
      this._close();
    }
  }

  // Enter / the Search button: pick the highlighted suggestion, or search now.
  async _submit() {
    clearTimeout(this._timer);
    const q = this.refs.input.value.trim();
    if (q.length < 2) {
      this._message("Type a city, county, state or country to search.");
      return;
    }
    if (this.results.length && this.activeIndex >= 0) {
      this._choose(this.results[this.activeIndex]);
      return;
    }
    // Nothing loaded yet (user typed fast and pressed Enter): fetch, then pick.
    this._message("Searching…");
    try {
      const cands = candidateResults(q);
      const results = [...cands, ...(await searchPlaces(q))];
      if (results.length) {
        this._choose(results[0]);
      } else {
        this.results = [];
        this._render();
        this._open();
      }
    } catch {
      this._render("We couldn't reach the search service. Try again in a moment.");
      this._open();
    }
  }

  _choose(desc) {
    this.refs.input.value = desc.kind === "candidate" ? desc.name : desc.label;
    this.results = [];
    this._render();
    this._close();
    this._message("");
    if (desc.kind === "candidate") this.handlers.onSelectCandidate?.(desc.slug);
    else this.handlers.onSelect?.(desc);
  }

  // ----- Rendering ---------------------------------------------------------

  _render(errorText) {
    const list = this.refs.list;
    list.innerHTML = "";
    if (errorText) {
      list.appendChild(emptyItem(errorText));
      return;
    }
    if (!this.results.length) {
      if (this.refs.input.value.trim().length >= 2) {
        list.appendChild(
          emptyItem(
            "No U.S. places or candidates found. Try a city and state, like “Sugar Land, TX”."
          )
        );
      }
      return;
    }
    this.results.forEach((r, i) => {
      const li = document.createElement("li");
      li.id = `search-opt-${i}`;
      li.setAttribute("role", "option");
      li.className = "search-option";
      li.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(i === this.activeIndex));

      const title = document.createElement("span");
      title.className = "search-option-title";
      title.textContent = r.name;

      const sub = document.createElement("span");
      sub.className = "search-option-sub";
      sub.textContent = r.kind === "candidate" ? r.subtitle : subtitle(r);
      if (r.kind === "candidate") li.classList.add("search-option-candidate");

// js/navigation.js
// The navigation state machine. Owns "where am I in the hierarchy right now",
// and provides descend / ascend / jump operations. It is UI- and map-agnostic:
// it just emits state and lets subscribers (the app) react.

import { PLACES, pathToNode, optionsForLevel } from "../data/places.js";
import { levelByKey } from "../data/levels.js";

// Levels offered in the "pick from a list" dropdowns, in order.
const BROWSE_LEVELS = ["state", "county", "city"];

export class Navigation {
  constructor() {
    this.root = PLACES;
    this.current = PLACES; // start at the globe
    // The exact spot being looked at, when it isn't simply the place's center:
    // a searched address or the user's GPS position. Districts (Congress,
    // legislature, schools, wards) are looked up for THIS point.
    this.point = null;
    this._subscribers = [];
  }

  // Subscribe to state changes. Returns an unsubscribe function.
  subscribe(fn) {
    this._subscribers.push(fn);
    fn(this.getState()); // emit current state immediately
    return () => {
      this._subscribers = this._subscribers.filter((f) => f !== fn);
    };
  }

  _emit() {
    const state = this.getState();
    for (const fn of this._subscribers) fn(state);
  }

  getState() {
    const path = pathToNode(this.current.id);
    return {
      current: this.current,
      path, // breadcrumb trail root -> current
      point: this.point || this.current.center,
      pointIsExact: !!this.point,
      children: this.current.children || [],
      canAscend: path.length > 1,
      canDescend: (this.current.children || []).length > 0,
      browse: this._browseModel(path),
    };
  }

  // Data for the dropdowns: one entry per level with its choices and the
  // currently selected place (if the path passes through that level).
  _browseModel(path) {
    return BROWSE_LEVELS.map((level) => {
      const { parent, options, selected } = optionsForLevel(path, level);
      return {
        level,
        label: levelByKey(level).label,
        parentId: parent.id,
        loading: parent.childrenState === "loading",
        options: options.map((o) => ({ id: o.id, name: o.name })),
        selectedId: selected ? selected.id : "",
      };
    });
  }

  _go(node, point = null) {
    this.current = node;
    this.point = point;
    this._emit();
  }

  // Drill down into a specific child node.
  descendTo(node) {
    this._go(node);
  }

  // Move up one level toward the globe.
  ascend() {
    const path = pathToNode(this.current.id);
    if (path.length > 1) this._go(path[path.length - 2]);
  }

  // Jump to any node in the tree by id.
  jumpTo(nodeId) {
    const path = pathToNode(nodeId);
    if (path.length) this._go(path[path.length - 1]);
  }

  // Go straight to the last node of a path (from search / geolocation).
  // `point` = the exact [lng, lat] to look up districts for.
  goToPath(path, point = null) {
    if (path && path.length) this._go(path[path.length - 1], point);
  }

  // Re-emit the current state (used after lists finish loading).
  refresh() {
    this._emit();
  }

  // Reset to the whole-world view.
  reset() {
    this._go(this.root);
  }
}

# Mapachusetts 🌎

**Politics, mapped to where you live.** An interactive 3D globe that shows every
layer of U.S. government covering a spot (country, state, congressional
district, state senate and house districts, county, city or town, school
district, and city wards where open data exists), plus the elections and town
halls that matter there.

- **Find a place 4 ways:** search, **Use my location**, the *Browse by list*
  menus (State → County → City), or just click the globe.
- **See the stack:** a *layer dock* of color-coded chips, each with a glowing
  outline on the map. Hover or click a chip to highlight that boundary.
- **Ballot by layer:** each layer of government has its own section (what it
  does, and the races it decides). Plus an *Events* tab for town halls, meetings
  and voting dates, and an Election Day countdown.
- **Every state, county and city** is reachable. States and counties are real,
  clickable shapes; counties and cities load from the Census the first time you
  open their parent.
- **U.S. only for now.** The world stays on the globe, but only the U.S. is lit
  up; everything else is greyed out and says it isn't available yet.
- **Candidate profiles:** click a candidate on the ballot (or search a name) to
  open a six-tab research profile: *In the News* (cited), *Funding*, *Career*,
  *Issues* (with voting records), *Sources* and *Myths & Facts*. `?candidate=maura-healey`
  is a shareable link.
- **Voting precincts and wards** for any U.S. spot (Census 2020 voting districts).
- **Night / Day** map themes, keyboard friendly (press `/` to search), phone
  layout with a bottom sheet.

> **Real vs. sample data.** Boundaries and districts are real (Census). The
> **Massachusetts 2026 governor and U.S. Senate races are real**: researched
> candidates (Healey, Minogue, Markey, Deaton) with cited news, funding, issues,
> careers, sources and myths, opened from the ballot, the search box or the
> intro. Everything else (other states' races, local offices, events) is a
> **SAMPLE placeholder**, labeled "Sample" in the UI.

## Run it

Static site using ES modules, so serve it over HTTP (not `file://`):

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1
# open http://localhost:8000
```

> **Keep `--bind 127.0.0.1`.** This folder also holds the Next.js app, whose
> `.env` file contains secret keys (`SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`). A plain
> `http.server` serves every file here to anyone on your network, `.env`
> included. `.env` is gitignored; just don't expose this folder. For the
> Next.js app itself see the section at the bottom.

Needs internet (map tiles, MapLibre, the Census service and the geocoder load
from public hosts). Geolocation needs a secure context; `localhost` counts,
production needs HTTPS. No API keys anywhere.

## Where does X go? (start here when adding data)

| I want to add or change...                      | Edit this | How |
| ----------------------------------------------- | --------- | --- |
| **Add or update a researched candidate**        | `supabase/seed-data/<slug>.json` (+ `lib/candidate-profiles.ts`), then `python3 scripts/export_candidates.py` | The export script rebuilds `data/political-data.generated.js`. Never edit that file by hand. See "Political data in the globe". |
| **Which candidates are in which race**          | `data/candidates.js` → `RACES` | List candidate slugs per race; names and parties come from the profiles. |
| **Real races / candidates** (your datasets)     | `data/civic.js` → `fetchRacesForPlace(placeId, stack)` | Return `Race` objects (`data/types.js`). Give each a **`kind`** (which layer decides it) and the UI files it under the right layer. Key district races on the ids in `stack` (e.g. `congress:4822`, `school:4819650`). |
| **Real events / town halls**                    | `data/civic.js` → `fetchEventsForPlace(placeId)` | Return `Event` objects. Optional `kind` adds a colored layer tag. |
| **Sample races/events for one place**           | `data/places.js` → that place's `races: []` / `events: []` | Use factories from `data/races.js` / `data/events.js`. Copy Sugar Land (TX) or Medford (MA). |
| A new **layer of government** (e.g. fire district) | `data/kinds.js` + a lookup in `data/census.js` (or `data/local-sources.js`) | `kinds.js` sets its icon, color and the plain-language blurb. |
| **City wards / council districts** for a city   | `data/local-sources.js` | Add one entry (ArcGIS or Socrata URL + field). It shows up automatically. Boston, Chicago and NYC are done. |
| A new **kind of race** (icon, tag)              | `data/races.js` → `CATEGORY_META` | |
| A new **kind of event**                         | `data/events.js` → `EVENT_TYPES` | |
| **Exact field names / shapes**                  | `data/types.js` | JSDoc for `Place`, `Race`, `Event`, `Jurisdiction`, `GeocodeResult`. Point prompts here. |
| **Geocoder** (text search)                      | `js/geocode.js` | Swap `PHOTON_URL`, or self-host Photon. Holds the U.S.-only filter. |
| **Which countries are active** on the globe     | `js/globe.js` → `ACTIVE_COUNTRIES` | ISO alpha-3 codes. Also needs places in `data/places.js` and a wider geocoder filter. |
| **Map colors / themes**                         | `js/globe.js` → `THEMES`; `styles.css` top | |
| **Layer colors** (used everywhere)              | `data/kinds.js` | One color per layer: map outline, dock chip and ballot section share it. |
| **Look and feel**                               | `styles.css`, `index.html` | CSS variables are at the top of `styles.css`. |

### How it fits together

```
 search / GPS / menus / globe click
              │
        js/navigation.js   (which place am I on? + the exact point)
              │
          js/app.js ────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │                                                      │
   data/civic.js  (the ONE data seam)                        js/globe.js  js/ui.js
     ├─ geography ─► data/census.js        real boundaries     (map layers)  (dock, ballot,
     │               data/local-sources.js wards, council                     events, menus)
     └─ politics  ─► data/candidates.js    REAL researched races + candidates
                     data/places.js        SAMPLE races + events (everything else)
```

When you land on a place, the app asks the **Census Bureau (TIGERweb)** which
boundaries contain the point, in parallel, and gets back a **stack** of
`Jurisdiction`s. Each one becomes a dock chip, a glowing outline, and a ballot
section. Races are matched to layers by their `kind`.

Races/events attached to a place (in `data/places.js`) are also **inherited by
everything below it**: put a governor race on the state, a mayor race on the
city.

### Districts follow the exact point

A city can span several congressional or legislative districts. The stack is
looked up for the **spot you searched or your GPS position**; for a plain city
click it uses the city's center, and the UI says so.

## Files

```

styles.css         All styling (Night/Day tokens at the top)

scripts/
  export_candidates.py  Teammates' candidate data -> data/political-data.generated.js

prototypes/

js/

  candidate-sheet.js  Candidate profile sheet (six tabs), ported from the React app
  navigation.js    "Where am I?" state + the exact point + menu choices
  globe.js         MapLibre 3D globe: world shading, clickable shapes, layer outlines, pins
  ui.js            Renders dock, ballot-by-layer, events, countdown, menus, messages
  search.js        Search-as-you-type box (accessible combobox)
  geocode.js       Text search (Photon), U.S.-only filter
  geolocation.js   Browser location, as a promise

data/
  civic.js         THE data seam. Swap sample politics for real data here
  candidates.js    Real candidates + the races they run in (merge logic from lib/candidates.ts)
  political-data.generated.js  GENERATED from the research app's data. Don't edit
  census.js        Census TIGERweb client: stack, boundaries, county/city lists
  local-sources.js City ward / council-district sources (Boston, Chicago, NYC)
  kinds.js         The layers of government: names, icons, colors, explanations
  places.js        Place tree + SAMPLE races/events + lookup helpers
  races.js         Race factories + category tags
  events.js        Event factories + event-type icons/colors
  levels.js        World > Country > State > County > City > District
  us-states.js     50 states + DC (names, centers, zooms, FIPS codes)
  types.js         JSDoc reference for every data shape
```

## Good to know

- **Where your data goes (privacy):** the text typed in the search box goes to
  the public geocoder `photon.komoot.io`. The coordinates of a searched spot or
  of the user's location (only when they press *Use my location*) go to the
  U.S. Census Bureau's TIGERweb service, and to the city open-data portals for
  Boston, Chicago and NYC when the point is in those cities. Nothing else leaves
  the browser. The public geocoder is shared and rate-limited, so self-host or
  use a paid one for production.
- **District maps can lag reality.** Boundaries are whatever the Census has
  published (currently the 120th Congress and 2026 legislative districts). Some
  states redrew maps for 2026, so the UI tells people to confirm with their
  local election office. Congressional districts are not guaranteed to match
  the maps used on Election Day.
- **Cities & towns:** in New England-style states (CT, ME, MA, MI, MN, NH, NJ,
  NY, PA, RI, VT, WI) towns come from Census "county subdivisions"; elsewhere,
  from "incorporated places". A spot with no city or town is shown as
  unincorporated, and the county covers it. A city that straddles counties is
  listed under the county holding its center.
- **Map tech:** MapLibre GL JS 6 (ES module from unpkg, version pinned in
  `js/globe.js` and `index.html`). Basemaps: OpenFreeMap (dark and bright).
  Country shading: MapLibre demo tiles. No keys needed.
- **Sample dates** are relative to today so demos never look stale. Election Day
  events use the real dates (Nov 3, 2026 and Nov 7, 2028).
- **Accessibility:** keyboard-friendly search, tabs and menus; visible focus
  rings; 44px+ touch targets; screen-reader labels; reduced-motion support.
  Full WCAG validation still needs testing with assistive technology and an
  accessibility review.
- **Precincts** come from the 2020 Census voting districts, which can be out of
  date (precincts change often). Treat them as a guide and confirm your polling
  place with your local election office. City *council* wards exist only for the
  three cities in `data/local-sources.js`.
- **Not covered yet:** U.S. territories (Puerto Rico, Guam, ...), real races
  outside Massachusetts, and automated tests.

## Political data in the globe

The candidate research app (below) is the **source of truth** for political
data. The globe is a static site with no build step, so it reads a generated
copy:

```
supabase/seed-data/*.json        politician + cited news summary   ┐
lib/candidate-profiles.ts        funding / issues / career / ...   ┴─► python3 scripts/export_candidates.py
                                                                          │
                                                       data/political-data.generated.js
                                                                          │
                           data/candidates.js  (merge by slug, same logic as lib/candidates.ts)
                                  │                          │
                    racesForState("MA") ──► ballot     getCandidate(slug) ──► js/candidate-sheet.js
```

**Add a candidate:** create `supabase/seed-data/<slug>.json` (copy an existing
one), optionally add a curated profile to `lib/candidate-profiles.ts`, run
`python3 scripts/export_candidates.py`, then list the slug in a race in
`RACES` in `data/candidates.js`. The Next.js app picks up the same files
(`node supabase/build-news-seed.mjs` rebuilds its SQL).

**Live data (not wired yet):** the globe reads the exported file, not Supabase,
so news summaries refresh whenever you re-run the export. To read Supabase
live instead, replace the bodies of `fetchRacesForPlace` in `data/civic.js`
with a call to Supabase's REST API using the **anon** key (it is designed to be
public; Row Level Security gives read-only access). Never put the
`service_role` key in browser code.

---

## Candidate research app (Next.js + Supabase)

> From the `politician_pages` / `candidate-search` branches. This is the
> political-data side of the project: candidate profiles, cited news
> summaries and the Supabase database. The globe UI above reads the same
> candidates through `data/candidates.js` (see "Political data in the globe").

A civic research site for Massachusetts candidates: search a candidate to see
cited summaries of their recent news coverage, funding, issue positions, career
history, sources, and common myths.

- **Framework:** Next.js (App Router) — frontend + API in one project
- **Database:** Supabase (Postgres)
- **Hosting:** Vercel (app) + Supabase (database)

### Routes

- `/` — landing page and the candidate research UI (search plus tabs for
  In the News, Funding, Career, Issues, Sources, and Myths & Facts)
- `/?candidate=<slug>` — opens a candidate's profile directly (shareable)
- `/news` — latest stored headlines, linking to the original reporting
- `/politicians/<slug>` — redirects to `/?candidate=<slug>`

### Where the data comes from

Each profile merges two sources by `slug` (see `lib/candidates.ts`):

- **Supabase** — `politicians` (name, office, party, bio, career history) and
  `politician_news_summaries` (AI-written summaries with numbered citations).
- **Curated profiles** — `lib/candidate-profiles.ts`, hand-written funding,
  issue, source, and myth data from the original candidate-search design.
  A profile without a Supabase row still appears in search.

Tabs with no data for a candidate show an empty state instead of hiding.

### Setup

#### 1. Install dependencies

```bash
npm install
```

#### 2. Create the database

In the Supabase dashboard, open **SQL Editor → New query** and run, in order:

1. [`supabase/schema.sql`](supabase/schema.sql) — tables, indexes, Row Level
   Security (public read).
2. [`supabase/news_seed.sql`](supabase/news_seed.sql) — the 2026 statewide
   candidates and their cited news summaries (Oct 10–24, 2026).

`news_seed.sql` is generated from `supabase/seed-data/*.json`. After editing
those files, rebuild it with `node supabase/build-news-seed.mjs`, which also
validates the citations.

#### 3. Environment variables

Values live in `.env` (gitignored):

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=https://<your-project>.supabase.co
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=<anon public key>
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=<service_role secret key>
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=<optional; only for npm run summarize>
```

- The URL and anon key are safe to expose to the browser.
- The `service_role` and Anthropic keys are secrets and are only used
  server-side. Never commit them or ship them to the browser.

#### 4. Run locally

```bash
npm run dev
```

Open http://localhost:3000.

### Refreshing the news

- `npm run ingest` — pulls RSS headlines into `articles`.
- `npm run summarize` — fetches article text (kept in memory only), links
  articles to politicians by full name, and writes cited summaries. Needs
  `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.
- `npm run news` — both, in order.

Only headlines, links, short snippets, and summaries are stored, never full
article text.

### Deploying to Vercel

1. Push this repo to GitHub.
2. In Vercel, import the repo.
3. Add the environment variables above in the Vercel project settings.
4. Deploy.

  { id: "career", label: "Career", icon: "🧭" },
  { id: "opinions", label: "Issues", icon: "🗣️" },
  { id: "sources", label: "Sources", icon: "🔗" },
  { id: "misconceptions", label: "Myths & Facts", icon: "🔍" },
];

const BIAS_LABELS = {
  nonpartisan: "Nonpartisan",
  center: "Center",
  "center-left": "Center-Left",
  "center-right": "Center-Right",
  left: "Left",
  right: "Right",
};

const TYPE_LABELS = {
  government: "Gov't record",
  nonprofit: "Nonprofit",
  factcheck: "Fact-checker",
  newspaper: "Newspaper",
  wire: "Wire service",
  academic: "Academic",
};

const STATUS_ICONS = { incumbent: "🏛️", running: "🗳️", former: "📋" };

// ----- Tiny DOM helper ------------------------------------------------------------

/** h("div", {class: "x", href: "..."}, child, "text", ...) */
function h(tag, attrs, ...children) {
  const el = document.createElement(tag);
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(attrs || {})) {
    if (v === false || v == null) continue;
    if (k === "class") el.className = v;
    else if (k === "text") el.textContent = v;
    else if (k.startsWith("on")) el.addEventListener(k.slice(2), v);
    else el.setAttribute(k, v === true ? "" : v);
  }
  for (const c of children.flat(Infinity)) {
    if (c == null || c === false) continue;
    el.append(c.nodeType ? c : document.createTextNode(String(c)));
  }
  return el;
}

/** Only http(s) links are rendered; anything else (e.g. javascript:) is dropped. */
function safeUrl(url) {
  return url && /^https?:\/\//i.test(url) ? url : undefined;
}

function link(href, text, cls) {
  const url = safeUrl(href);
  return url
    ? h("a", { href: url, class: cls, target: "_blank", rel: "noopener noreferrer" }, text)
    : h("span", { class: cls }, text);
}

const DATE_ONLY = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
function formatDate(value) {
  if (!value) return null;
  const d = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(value);
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    year: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    timeZone: DATE_ONLY.test(value) ? "UTC" : "America/New_York",
  });
}

function formatMoney(n) {
  if (n >= 1_000_000) return `$${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
  if (n >= 1_000) return `$${(n / 1_000).toFixed(0)}K`;
  return `$${n}`;
}

function alignmentLabel(score) {
  if (score >= 80) return { text: "Strongly supports", cls: "align-strong-yes" };
  if (score >= 60) return { text: "Leans in favor", cls: "align-yes" };
  if (score >= 41) return { text: "Mixed position", cls: "align-mixed" };
  if (score >= 21) return { text: "Leans against", cls: "align-no" };
  return { text: "Strongly opposed", cls: "align-strong-no" };
}

function voteClass(vote) {
  const v = String(vote).toLowerCase();
  if (["yes", "co-sponsor", "sponsored", "supported", "introduced"].includes(v)) return "vote-yes";
  if (v.startsWith("no")) return "vote-no";
  return "vote-neutral";
}

const timeOf = (value) => (value ? Date.parse(value) : Number.NaN);

/** Open on the freshest tab that has data. */
function defaultTab(c) {
  if (c.news) return "news";
  if (c.funding) return "funding";
  return "career";
}

// ----- The sheet ------------------------------------------------------------------

export class CandidateSheet {
  /**
   * @param {HTMLElement} root  the <aside> that holds the sheet
   * @param {{onClose?: () => void}} [handlers]
   */
  constructor(root, handlers = {}) {
    this.root = root;
    this.handlers = handlers;
    this.slug = null;
    this.tab = "news";
    this._returnFocus = null;
    root.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") this.close();
    });
  }

  get isOpen() {
    return !this.root.hidden;
  }

  /** Show a candidate. Returns false if we have no data for that slug. */
  open(slug, { focus = true } = {}) {
    const c = getCandidate(slug);
    if (!c) return false;
    if (!this.isOpen) this._returnFocus = document.activeElement;
    this.slug = slug;
    this.tab = defaultTab(c);
    this.root.hidden = false;
    document.body.classList.add("has-candidate");
    this._render(c);
    // Let the slide-in animation start from the hidden state. preventScroll
    // matters: focusing something inside a container that is still translated
    // off-screen would otherwise make the browser scroll the (overflow:hidden)
    // stage sideways to "reveal" it.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      this.root.classList.add("is-open");
      if (focus) this.root.querySelector(".cs-close")?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
    this._setUrl(slug);
    return true;
  }

  close() {
    if (!this.isOpen) return;
    this.root.classList.remove("is-open");
    document.body.classList.remove("has-candidate");
    this.root.hidden = true;
    this.slug = null;
    this._setUrl(null);
    this._returnFocus?.focus?.();
    this._returnFocus = null;
    this.handlers.onClose?.();
  }

  // Make the profile shareable (?candidate=slug) without navigating.
  _setUrl(slug) {
    try {
      const url = new URL(window.location.href);
      if (slug) url.searchParams.set("candidate", slug);
      else url.searchParams.delete("candidate");
      window.history.replaceState(null, "", url);
    } catch {
      /* file:// or sandboxed: sharing links just won't update */
    }
  }

  _setTab(id, focusTab = false) {
    this.tab = id;
    for (const t of TABS) {
      const active = t.id === id;
      const btn = this.root.querySelector(`#cs-tab-${t.id}`);
      const panel = this.root.querySelector(`#cs-panel-${t.id}`);
      btn.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(active));
      btn.tabIndex = active ? 0 : -1;
      panel.hidden = !active;
    }
    if (focusTab) this.root.querySelector(`#cs-tab-${id}`).focus({ preventScroll: true });
    this.root.querySelector(".cs-scroll").scrollTop = 0;
  }

  _onTabKey(e) {
    const i = TABS.findIndex((t) => t.id === this.tab);
    let next = -1;
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight") next = (i + 1) % TABS.length;
    else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") next = (i - 1 + TABS.length) % TABS.length;
    else if (e.key === "Home") next = 0;
    else if (e.key === "End") next = TABS.length - 1;
    if (next < 0) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    this._setTab(TABS[next].id, true);
  }

  // ----- Rendering ---------------------------------------------------------------

  _render(c) {
    const panels = {
      news: () => this._news(c.news),
      funding: () => this._funding(c.funding),
      career: () => this._career(c),
      opinions: () => this._issues(c.opinions),
      sources: () => this._sources(c.sources, c.news),
      misconceptions: () => this._myths(c.misconceptions),
    };

    const tabs = h(
      "div",
      { class: "cs-tabs", role: "tablist", "aria-label": "Candidate information" },
      TABS.map((t) =>
        h(
          "button",
          {
            class: "cs-tab",
            type: "button",
            id: `cs-tab-${t.id}`,
            role: "tab",
            "aria-selected": String(t.id === this.tab),
            "aria-controls": `cs-panel-${t.id}`,
            tabindex: t.id === this.tab ? "0" : "-1",
            onclick: () => this._setTab(t.id),
            onkeydown: (e) => this._onTabKey(e),
          },
          h("span", { "aria-hidden": "true" }, t.icon),
          " ",
          t.label
        )
      )
    );

    const body = h(
      "div",
      { class: "cs-scroll" },
      TABS.map((t) =>
        h(
          "div",
          {
            class: "cs-panel",
            id: `cs-panel-${t.id}`,
            role: "tabpanel",
            "aria-labelledby": `cs-tab-${t.id}`,
            tabindex: "0",
            hidden: t.id !== this.tab,
          },
          panels[t.id]()
        )
      )
    );

    this.root.replaceChildren(
      h(
        "button",
        {
          class: "cs-close",
          type: "button",
          onclick: () => this.close(),
          "aria-label": `Close ${c.name}'s profile`,
        },
        h("span", { "aria-hidden": "true" }, "←"),
        " Back"
      ),
      this._header(c),
      tabs,
      body,
      h(
        "footer",
        { class: "cs-foot" },
        "Research profile from the Mapachusetts candidate database. News summaries are AI-generated from linked reporting. Always verify claims with the sources."
      )
    );
  }

  _header(c) {
    const party = String(c.party || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    const photo = safeUrl(c.photo);
    const avatar = h("div", { class: "cs-avatar", "data-party": party, "aria-hidden": photo ? null : "true" });
    if (photo) {
      const img = h("img", { src: photo, alt: `Official photo of ${c.name}`, referrerpolicy: "no-referrer" });
      // Fall back to party-colored initials if the portrait fails to load.
      img.addEventListener("error", () => {
        avatar.replaceChildren(document.createTextNode(initials(c.name)));
        avatar.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      });
      avatar.append(img);
    } else {
      avatar.textContent = initials(c.name);
    }

    return h(
      "header",
      { class: "cs-head" },
      avatar,
      h(
        "div",
        { class: "cs-meta" },
        h("h2", { class: "cs-name", text: c.name }),
        c.role && h("p", { class: "cs-role", text: c.role }),
        h(
          "div",
          { class: "cs-badges" },
          c.party && h("span", { class: "cs-party", "data-party": party, text: c.party }),
          c.status &&
            h("span", {
              class: "cs-status",
              "data-status-type": c.status.statusType,
              text: c.status.statusLabel,
            })
        ),
        c.status?.termInfo && h("p", { class: "cs-term", text: c.status.termInfo }),
        link(c.openSecretsUrl, "View on OpenSecrets ↗", "cs-extlink")
      )
    );
  }

  _empty(...content) {
    return h("p", { class: "cs-empty" }, ...content);
  }

  _plain(text) {
    return h("div", { class: "cs-box cs-plain" }, h("span", { class: "cs-box-label", text: "In plain English" }), h("p", { text }));
  }

  _why(text) {
    return h("div", { class: "cs-box cs-why" }, h("span", { class: "cs-box-label", text: "🔍 Why people are searching this" }), h("p", { text }));
  }

  // -- Tab: In the News ------------------------------------------------------------

  _news(news) {
    if (!news) return this._empty("No recent news coverage has been summarized for this candidate yet.");

    const numbers = new Set(news.citations.map((c) => c.n));
    const dated = news.citations
      .filter((c) => !Number.isNaN(timeOf(c.published_at)))
      .sort((a, b) => timeOf(a.published_at) - timeOf(b.published_at));
    const from = formatDate(dated[0]?.published_at);
    const to = formatDate(dated[dated.length - 1]?.published_at);
    const range = from && to ? (from === to ? ` from ${from}` : ` from ${from} to ${to}`) : "";
    const updated = formatDate(news.generated_at);

    const paragraphs = String(news.summary)
      .split(/\n\s*\n/)
      .map((p) => p.trim())
      .filter(Boolean)
      .map((p) => h("p", {}, citedText(p, numbers)));

    return [
      h("p", { class: "cs-disclaimer", text: `AI-generated summary of news coverage${range}. Verify claims using the linked sources.${updated ? ` Updated ${updated}.` : ""}` }),
      h("div", { class: "cs-summary" }, paragraphs),
      news.citations.length > 0 && h("h3", { class: "cs-sub", text: "Sources" }),
      news.citations.length > 0 &&
        h(
          "ol",
          { class: "cs-cites" },
          news.citations.map((c) => {
            const meta = [c.source, formatDate(c.published_at)].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
            return h(
              "li",
              { id: `cs-cite-${c.n}`, value: c.n },
              link(c.url, c.title),
              meta && h("span", { class: "cs-meta-inline", text: meta })
            );
          })
        ),
    ];
  }

  // -- Tab: Funding ----------------------------------------------------------------

  _bars(items, label) {
    if (!items.length) return null;
    const maxPct = Math.max(...items.map((s) => s.pct));
    return h(
      "ul",
      { class: "cs-bars", "aria-label": label },
      items.map((s) =>
        h(
          "li",
          {},
          h("div", { class: "cs-bar-label" }, h("span", { text: s.label }), h("span", { class: "cs-bar-amount", text: formatMoney(s.amount) })),
          h(
            "div",
            { class: "cs-bar-track", role: "img", "aria-label": `${s.label}: ${s.pct}% of top contributions` },
            h("div", { class: "cs-bar-fill", style: `width:${maxPct > 0 ? (s.pct / maxPct) * 100 : 0}%` })
          )
        )
      )
    );
  }

  _funding(f) {
    if (!f) {
      return this._empty(
        "Campaign finance data hasn't been added for this candidate yet. Federal filings are on ",
        link("https://www.fec.gov/data/", "FEC.gov"),
        " and ",
        link("https://www.opensecrets.org", "OpenSecrets"),
        "; Massachusetts state races are on ",
        link("https://www.ocpf.us", "OCPF"),
        "."
      );
    }
    const stat = (label, value) =>
      h("div", { class: "cs-stat" }, h("span", { class: "cs-stat-label", text: label }), h("span", { class: "cs-stat-value", text: value }));
    return [
      h("div", { class: "cs-stats" }, stat("Total raised", f.total), stat("Top industry", f.topIndustry), stat("Small donors (<$200)", f.smallDonorPct)),
      f.plainEnglish && this._plain(f.plainEnglish),
      f.whyItMatters && this._why(f.whyItMatters),
      h("h3", { class: "cs-sub", text: "Top funding sources by industry" }),
      this._bars(f.sources, "Top funding sources breakdown"),
      f.foreignSources.length > 0 && h("h3", { class: "cs-sub", text: "Foreign policy & tariff-related PAC contributions" }),
      f.foreignSources.length > 0 && this._bars(f.foreignSources, "Foreign policy funding breakdown"),
      h("p", { class: "cs-note" }, "Data sourced from ", link("https://www.opensecrets.org", "OpenSecrets.org"), ". Verify figures directly on their platform."),
    ];
  }

  // -- Tab: Career -----------------------------------------------------------------

  _statusCard(s) {
    return h(
      "div",
      { class: "cs-statuscard" },
      h(
        "div",
        { class: "cs-statuscard-top" },
        h("span", { class: "cs-status-icon", "aria-hidden": "true", text: STATUS_ICONS[s.statusType] || "📋" }),
        h("div", {}, h("div", { class: "cs-status-title", text: `${s.currentTitle} — ${s.state}` }), h("div", { class: "cs-status-term", text: s.termInfo })),
        h("span", { class: "cs-status", "data-status-type": s.statusType, text: s.statusLabel })
      ),
      h("div", { class: "cs-box cs-plain" }, h("span", { class: "cs-box-label", text: "What this means" }), h("p", { text: s.plainEnglish })),
      s.runningFor && h("p", { class: "cs-running" }, h("span", { class: "cs-box-label", text: "Running for" }), " ", h("strong", { text: s.runningFor })),
      (s.committees || []).length > 0 &&
        h("div", { class: "cs-committees" }, h("span", { class: "cs-box-label", text: "Committee assignments" }), h("ul", {}, s.committees.map((n) => h("li", { text: n }))))
    );
  }

  _career(c) {
    if (!c.bio && !c.status && c.career.length === 0) {
      return this._empty("Career history hasn't been added for this candidate yet.");
    }
    return [
      c.status && this._statusCard(c.status),
      c.bio && h("p", { class: "cs-bio", text: c.bio }),
      c.career.length > 0 && h("p", { class: "cs-intro", text: "Roles held in chronological order, most recent first." }),
      c.career.length > 0 &&
        h(
          "ol",
          { class: "cs-timeline", "aria-label": "Career timeline" },
          c.career.map((e) =>
            h(
              "li",
              {},
              h("div", { class: "cs-years", text: e.years }),
              h("div", { class: "cs-role-block" }, h("strong", { text: e.title }), e.org && h("em", { text: e.org }), e.description && h("p", { text: e.description }))
            )
          )
        ),
    ];
  }

  // -- Tab: Issues -----------------------------------------------------------------

  _subIssue(topicId, sub) {
    const score = typeof sub.alignment === "number" ? sub.alignment : null;
    const align = score === null ? null : alignmentLabel(score);
    const detailId = `cs-sub-${topicId}-${sub.id}`;

    const detail = h(
      "div",
      { class: "cs-sub-detail", id: detailId, hidden: true },
      sub.plainEnglish && this._plain(sub.plainEnglish),
      sub.whyItMatters && this._why(sub.whyItMatters),
      h("details", { class: "cs-deep" }, h("summary", { text: "Dig deeper" }), h("p", { text: sub.detail })),
      sub.voteRecord && sub.voteRecord.length > 0 && h("h4", { text: "Vote record" }),
      sub.voteRecord &&
        sub.voteRecord.length > 0 &&
        h(
          "ul",
          { class: "cs-votes" },
          sub.voteRecord.map((v) =>
            h("li", {}, h("span", { class: "cs-vote-year", text: v.year }), h("span", { class: "cs-vote-bill", text: v.bill }), h("span", { class: `cs-vote ${voteClass(v.vote)}`, text: v.vote }))
          )
        )
    );

    const chevron = h("span", { class: "cs-chevron", "aria-hidden": "true", text: "▾" });
    const toggle = h(
      "button",
      { class: "cs-sub-toggle", type: "button", "aria-expanded": "false", "aria-controls": detailId },
      h("span", { class: "cs-sub-top" }, h("span", { class: "cs-sub-label", text: sub.label }), chevron),
      align &&
        h(
          "span",
          { class: "cs-align" },
          h("span", { class: "cs-align-track", "aria-hidden": "true" }, h("span", { class: `cs-align-fill ${align.cls}`, style: `width:${score}%` })),
          h("span", { class: `cs-align-label ${align.cls}`, text: `${align.text} · ${score}%` })
        )
    );
    toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const open = toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") !== "true";
      toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
      detail.hidden = !open;
      chevron.textContent = open ? "▴" : "▾";
    });
    return h("div", { class: "cs-subissue" }, toggle, detail);
  }

  _issues(opinions) {
    if (!opinions.length) {
      return this._empty("Issue positions and voting records haven't been compiled for this candidate yet. The In the News tab covers positions reported in recent coverage.");
    }
    return [
      h("p", { class: "cs-intro", text: "Expand any issue to read the candidate's position and voting record." }),
      opinions.map((topic) =>
        h(
          "section",
          { class: "cs-topic" },
          h(
            "div",
            { class: "cs-topic-head" },
            h("span", { "aria-hidden": "true", text: topic.icon }),
            h("h3", { text: topic.topic }),
            h("span", { class: "cs-topic-count", text: `${topic.subIssues.length} issue${topic.subIssues.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}` })
          ),
          topic.subIssues.map((s) => this._subIssue(topic.id, s))
        )
      ),
    ];
  }

  // -- Tab: Sources ----------------------------------------------------------------

  _sources(sources, news) {
    const cited = news ? news.citations : [];
    if (!sources.length && !cited.length) return this._empty("No research sources have been added for this candidate yet.");
    return [
      sources.length > 0
        ? [
            h(
              "p",
              { class: "cs-intro" },
              "Every claim in this profile draws from the sources below, from outlets across the political spectrum so you can cross-reference. Bias ratings come from ",
              link("https://adfontesmedia.com", "Ad Fontes Media"),
              " and ",
              link("https://www.allsides.com", "AllSides"),
              "."
            ),
            h(
              "ul",
              { class: "cs-sources", "aria-label": "Research sources" },
              sources.map((s) =>
                h(
                  "li",
                  {},
                  h(
                    "div",
                    { class: "cs-source-head" },
                    link(s.url, `${s.name} ↗`, "cs-source-name"),
                    h("div", { class: "cs-source-tags" }, h("span", { class: `cs-tag bias-${s.bias}`, text: BIAS_LABELS[s.bias] || s.bias }), h("span", { class: "cs-tag cs-tag-type", text: TYPE_LABELS[s.type] || s.type }))
                  ),
                  h("p", { text: s.description })
                )
              )
            ),
          ]
        : h("p", { class: "cs-intro", text: "These are the news articles behind the In the News summary. Curated research sources haven't been added for this candidate yet." }),
      cited.length > 0 && h("h3", { class: "cs-sub", text: "News articles cited in “In the News”" }),
      cited.length > 0 &&
        h(
          "ul",
          { class: "cs-sources", "aria-label": "News articles cited in the summary" },
          cited.map((c) =>
            h("li", {}, h("div", { class: "cs-source-head" }, link(c.url, `${c.title} ↗`, "cs-source-name")), h("p", { text: [c.source, formatDate(c.published_at)].filter(Boolean).join(" · ") }))
          )
        ),
    ];
  }

  // -- Tab: Myths & Facts ----------------------------------------------------------

  _myths(items) {
    if (!items.length) return this._empty("No common misconceptions have been documented for this candidate yet.");
    return [
      h("p", { class: "cs-intro", text: "The most widely shared misconceptions about this candidate, each addressed with verifiable facts and a primary source you can check yourself." }),
      items.map((m) =>
        h(
          "article",
          { class: "cs-myth" },
          h("div", { class: "cs-myth-cat", text: m.category }),
          h(
            "div",
            { class: "cs-myth-claim" },
            h("div", { class: "cs-myth-head" }, h("span", { "aria-hidden": "true", text: "✕" }), " Common claim"),
            h("p", { text: `“${m.myth}”` }),
            safeUrl(m.mythSourceUrl) && link(m.mythSourceUrl, `Where this claim comes from: ${m.mythSourceLabel || "source"} ↗`, "cs-myth-link")
          ),
          h(
            "div",
            { class: "cs-myth-reality" },
            h("div", { class: "cs-myth-head" }, h("span", { "aria-hidden": "true", text: "✓" }), " What the record shows"),
            h("p", { text: m.reality }),
            link(m.sourceUrl, `Verify this: ${m.sourceLabel} ↗`, "cs-myth-link")
          )
        )
      ),
    ];
  }
}

// Turn "[1]" markers whose number has a matching citation into links to it.
// Unknown markers stay plain text (ported from components/CitedText.tsx).
function citedText(text, validNumbers) {
  const nodes = [];
  const re = /\[(\d+)\]/g;
  let last = 0;
  let m;
  while ((m = re.exec(text)) !== null) {
    const n = Number(m[1]);
    if (!validNumbers.has(n)) continue;
    if (m.index > last) nodes.push(text.slice(last, m.index));

// data/census.js
// U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb client: the source of real boundaries for every
// state, county, city/town, congressional district, state legislative district
// and school district in the country.
//
//   https://tigerweb.geo.census.gov/arcgis/rest/services/TIGERweb/
//
// Free, no API key, and allows browser requests (CORS). Layer IDs change as
// the Census adds new vintages (e.g. "120th Congressional Districts"), so they
// are looked up by NAME at runtime, with known IDs as a fallback.
//
// WHAT THIS GIVES THE APP
//   identifyStack(lng, lat)   -> every government layer covering a point
//   fetchBoundary(j)          -> the outline of one of those layers (GeoJSON)
//   listCounties(stateFips)   -> all counties in a state
//   listMunicipalities(county)-> all cities / towns in a county
//   childShapes(...)          -> clickable polygons for all states / a state's counties
//
// BOUNDARY CAVEAT: congressional and legislative maps are whatever the Census
// has published. States that redrew maps for 2026 may be ahead of (or behind)
// the Census data, so the UI tells people to confirm with their election office.

import { KIND_ORDER } from "./kinds.js";
import { findLocalLayers } from "./local-sources.js";

// TIGERweb has one MapServer per vintage. Most layers come from "Current"
// (120th Congress, 2026 legislative districts); voting districts (precincts and
// wards) are only published with the 2020 Census.
const SERVICES = {
  current:
    "https://tigerweb.geo.census.gov/arcgis/rest/services/TIGERweb/tigerWMS_Current/MapServer",
  census2020:
    "https://tigerweb.geo.census.gov/arcgis/rest/services/TIGERweb/tigerWMS_Census2020/MapServer",
};

// Layer IDs change as the Census adds vintages, so they are looked up by NAME at
// runtime; `id` is the fallback if that lookup fails.
const LAYERS = {
  states: { service: "current", id: 80, pattern: /^States$/ },
  counties: { service: "current", id: 82, pattern: /^Counties$/ },
  congress: { service: "current", id: 54, pattern: /^\d+(st|nd|rd|th) Congressional Districts$/ },
  senate: { service: "current", id: 56, pattern: /State Legislative Districts - Upper$/ },
  house: { service: "current", id: 58, pattern: /State Legislative Districts - Lower$/ },
  unified: { service: "current", id: 14, pattern: /^Unified School Districts$/ },
  secondary: { service: "current", id: 16, pattern: /^Secondary School Districts$/ },
  elementary: { service: "current", id: 18, pattern: /^Elementary School Districts$/ },
  places: { service: "current", id: 28, pattern: /^Incorporated Places$/ },
  cdp: { service: "current", id: 30, pattern: /^Census Designated Places$/ },
  subdivisions: { service: "current", id: 22, pattern: /^County Subdivisions$/ },
  vtd: { service: "census2020", id: 58, pattern: /^Voting Districts$/ },
};

// States where towns/townships (county subdivisions) are the real local
// governments. Everywhere else, incorporated places are.
const STRONG_MCD_STATES = new Set([
  "09", "23", "25", "26", "27", "33", "34", "36", "42", "44", "50", "55",
]);

// How much to simplify each outline (degrees). Bigger = smaller download.
const SIMPLIFY = {
  state: 0.02,
  county: 0.004,
  congress: 0.004,
  senate: 0.003,
  house: 0.002,
  city: 0.0008,
  school: 0.0015,
  ward: 0.0005,
  precinct: 0.0003,
};

// ----- Plumbing --------------------------------------------------------------

const memo = new Map();
function remember(key, make) {
  if (!memo.has(key)) {
    const p = make().catch((err) => {
      memo.delete(key); // never cache failures
      throw err;
    });
    memo.set(key, p);
  }
  return memo.get(key);
}

// One request, with a timeout. Census services are public and occasionally slow,
// so a failed attempt is retried once before giving up (the UI then falls back
// gracefully; see the "error" state of the layer dock).
const TIMEOUT_MS = 12000;

async function getJsonOnce(url, signal) {
  const ctrl = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), TIMEOUT_MS);
  const onAbort = () => ctrl.abort();
  signal?.addEventListener("abort", onAbort);
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { signal: ctrl.signal });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Census service error (${res.status})`);
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.error) throw new Error(data.error.message || "Census query failed");
    return data;
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    signal?.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
  }
}

async function getJson(url, signal) {
  try {
    return await getJsonOnce(url, signal);
  } catch (err) {
    if (signal?.aborted) throw err; // the caller cancelled: don't retry
    return getJsonOnce(url, signal); // one retry
  }
}

function resolveLayers() {
  return remember("layers", async () => {
    const found = {};
    await Promise.all(
      Object.keys(SERVICES).map(async (svcKey) => {
        try {
          const svc = await getJson(`${SERVICES[svcKey]}?f=json`);
          found[svcKey] = svc.layers || [];
        } catch {
          found[svcKey] = [];
        }
      })
    );
    const out = {};
    for (const [key, def] of Object.entries(LAYERS)) {
      const hit = (found[def.service] || []).find(
        (l) => def.pattern.test(l.name) && !/Labels$/.test(l.name)
      );
      out[key] = { url: SERVICES[def.service], id: hit ? hit.id : def.id };
    }
    return out;
  });
}
